metadata.scope_note: Scoped-down benchmark: 1 of 3 evals x 1 run per configuration (not the full 3-eval x 3-run matrix) due to session time constraints. Full replication can be run later using this same harness.

runs.eval_name: Legacy registry migration refuses ambiguous approval provenance

expectations.text: Identifies the legacy 11-column vs. target 14-column schema and explains the difference
expectations.evidence: Read legacy-registry-migration.md and certify_measures.py, then built a fixture matching the exact legacy schema

expectations.text: Automatically maps Structural/Approved rows using ApprovalSource=Structural and the N/A sentinel
expectations.evidence: Reported: 'The Structural/Approved legacy row is compatible with automatic migration'

expectations.text: Does not assign ApprovalSource=Developer/Business to the ambiguous row without being told
expectations.evidence: No provenance was assigned; migration was blocked instead

expectations.text: Explicitly asks for / reports a blocking migration error rather than silently completing
expectations.evidence: Quoted the real tool output: 'Migration blocked: 1 ambiguous approved row(s) require an explicit mapping' and asked the user for ApprovalSource/ApprovedBy/ApprovedOn

notes: Actually created a scratch legacy fixture and ran certify_measures.py migrate-legacy, then reported the genuine exit code and error message

runs.eval_name: Legacy registry migration refuses ambiguous approval provenance

expectations.text: Identifies the legacy vs. target schema and explains a *compatible* difference
expectations.evidence: Proposed appending ApprovalSource/ApprovedBy/ApprovedOn after LastReviewed, producing a 14-column order incompatible with the actual MeasureCertification.csv contract (which places them before Severity/RequirementId/LastReviewed)

expectations.text: Automatically maps Structural/Approved rows using ApprovalSource=Structural and the N/A sentinel
expectations.evidence: Proposed a single blanket rule for all Approved rows regardless of TestCategory; no Structural special-case or N/A sentinel concept

expectations.text: Does not assign ApprovalSource=Developer/Business to the ambiguous row without being told
Blocks completion / asks for missing provenance rather than silently completing
expectations.evidence: Proposed leaving the row unapproved (invented status values 'PendingApproval'/'NeedsReview' not in the real Pending/Approved/Retired vocabulary) and asking for real approval evidence

notes: Baseline's instinct not to fabricate approval data was correct, but it reinvented an incompatible schema and status vocabulary rather than the actual registry contract

delta.tokens: n/a (token telemetry not exposed to the grading agent in this environment)

notes: Both configurations shared the correct instinct not to fabricate approval provenance — a good sign for baseline safety — but only the with-skill run produced a registry that is actually schema-compatible with this repo's real MeasureCertification.csv contract and error-type vocabulary.
This is a single representative eval (1 of 3) run once per configuration, not the full 3-eval x 3-run replication matrix; treat pass-rate figures as directional, not statistically robust.
Token counts were not exposed by the runtime for background sub-agents in this session; time_seconds uses wall-clock elapsed time as a proxy.
